example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আকাট মূর্খ, এত সহজ কথাও বুঝতে পারে না।
এই আকাট মূর্খের কথা শুনে হাসি পায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is an utter fool; he can't even understand such simple words.
Hearing this blockhead talk makes me laugh.
note: This idiom emphasizes extreme stupidity in a straightforward, unrefined manner, common in Bengali vernacular.
